text:
Gold Price in 2009
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2009, the LBMA gold price rose 18.3% between 2009-01-30 ($920) and 2009-12-30 ($1,088). The highest sampled price was $1,176 in November and the lowest was $883 in April. The mean of these observations was $981. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
